<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="no">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#141516">
<script>
/* ==================================================================
   PROJECT DETAILS — edit these before sending to the client
================================================================== */
window.CONFIG = {
  projectName: 'Voielia – nytt hus',
  tagline: 'Familiebolig over tre etasjer med egen hybel',
  address: 'Voielia (ved nr. 1), 4623 Kristiansand · gnr. 11 bnr. 104',
  price: '',                       // tom = prisen vises ikke
  agentName: '',                   // tom = kontaktknappen vises ikke
  agentTitle: '',
  phone: '',
  email: '',
}
</script>
<title>Voielia – nytt hus · 3D-visning</title>
<style>
  :root{--accent:#c8873c;--panel:rgba(18,19,21,.78);--panel2:rgba(18,19,21,.9);--safe-b:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);--safe-t:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#141516;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;touch-action:none;overscroll-behavior:none}
  canvas{display:block;touch-action:none}
  .serif{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif}
  button,.btn{font:inherit;font-size:13px;border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--panel);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
  button:hover,.btn:hover{background:var(--panel2)}
  button.on{background:var(--accent)}
  button.primary,.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
  button.primary:hover,.btn.primary:hover{background:#d8964a}
  button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:default}
  #hud{position:fixed;top:calc(14px + var(--safe-t));left:14px;color:#fff;background:var(--panel);padding:9px 14px;border-radius:10px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;pointer-events:none;max-width:330px;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
  #hudname{font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
  #room{font-size:13.5px}
  #hint{opacity:.7;font-size:12px}
  #bar{position:fixed;top:calc(14px + var(--safe-t));right:14px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;max-width:66vw;z-index:5}
  .seg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;background:var(--panel);border-radius:9px;padding:3px 3px 3px 10px;color:#fff;font-size:13px;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
  .seg span{opacity:.75;margin-right:4px}
  .seg button{background:transparent;padding:5px 11px;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;backdrop-filter:none}
  .seg button.on{background:var(--accent)}
  #levels{display:none}
  @media (max-width:700px){#views span{display:none}#views button{padding:5px 7px;font-size:12px}#views{padding:3px}}
  #lightbtn{display:inline-flex}
  #timebar,#styles{display:none !important}
  body.sheet #timebar,body.sheet #styles{display:flex !important}
  #fade{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#0d0e0f;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .38s ease;z-index:15}
  #fade.on{opacity:1}
  #cross{display:none !important;position:fixed;left:50%;top:50%;width:6px;height:6px;margin:-3px 0 0 -3px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;opacity:.7;pointer-events:none}
  #styles{position:fixed;bottom:calc(16px + var(--safe-b));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;background:var(--panel);padding:6px 8px 6px 14px;border-radius:12px;color:#fff;font-size:13px;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
  #styles span{opacity:.75;margin-right:4px}
  #styles button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
  #styles button.on{background:var(--accent)}
  #timebar{position:fixed;bottom:calc(64px + var(--safe-b));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:var(--panel);padding:7px 12px;border-radius:12px;color:#fff;font-size:13px;width:min(620px,92vw);box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
  #timebar input[type=range]{flex:1;accent-color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;min-width:60px}
  #timebar #todlabel{min-width:132px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  #timebar button{padding:5px 9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
  /* welcome screen */
  #start{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:20;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:flex-start;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(10,11,12,.82) 0%,rgba(10,11,12,.55) 42%,rgba(10,11,12,.05) 75%);color:#fff;transition:opacity .8s ease}
  #start.hide{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
  #start .card{padding:0 56px calc(56px + var(--safe-b));max-width:520px}
  #start .eyebrow{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.75}
  #start h1{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:400;font-size:56px;line-height:1.02;margin:10px 0 10px}
  #start .tag{font-size:16px;opacity:.85;margin-bottom:22px;line-height:1.45}
  #start .meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:6px 18px;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:20px}
  #start .meta dt{opacity:.6}
  #start .meta dd{margin:0}
  #start .price{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:26px}
  #start .facts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:26px}
  #start .facts span{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:20px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:13px}
  #start .cta{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  #start .cta button{font-size:15px;padding:12px 20px}
  #start .contactline{margin-top:22px;font-size:13.5px;opacity:.8}
  #start .contactline a{color:#fff}
  #start .loading{margin-top:14px;font-size:13px;opacity:.75;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
  #start.ready .loading{display:none}
  .spin{width:14px;height:14px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-top-color:#fff;border-radius:50%;animation:sp 0.9s linear infinite}
  @keyframes sp{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
  #start .help{margin-top:12px;font-size:12.5px;opacity:.6;line-height:1.5}
  body.touch #start .help .desk,body:not(.touch) #start .help .tch{display:none}
  body.welcome #bar,body.welcome #hud,body.welcome #timebar,body.welcome #styles,body.welcome #cross,body.welcome #joy{display:none !important}
  /* contact */
  #contact{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:30;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
  #contact.show{display:flex}
  #contact .panel{background:#18191b;color:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:26px 28px;width:min(360px,88vw);position:relative;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
  #contact .x{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
  #contact .eyebrow{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.6}
  #contact h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:400;font-size:26px;margin:6px 0 2px}
  #contact .role{opacity:.7;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:6px}
  #contact .phone{font-size:18px;margin:6px 0 18px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  #contact .acts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
  #contact .acts .btn{justify-content:center;padding:11px;font-size:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
  #contact .acts .btn.primary{background:var(--accent)}
  #contact .about{margin-top:16px;font-size:12.5px;opacity:.6;line-height:1.45}
  /* touch joystick */
  #joy{position:fixed;left:calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));bottom:calc(26px + var(--safe-b));width:118px;height:118px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);display:none;touch-action:none;z-index:4;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(4px);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
  #joyknob{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:50px;height:50px;margin:-25px 0 0 -25px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
  body.touch.walking #joy{display:block}
  body.touch #cross{display:none}
  /* tour */
  #tourcard{position:fixed;left:28px;bottom:calc(124px + var(--safe-b));max-width:380px;background:var(--panel);color:#fff;padding:18px 22px;border-radius:14px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease;pointer-events:none;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
  #tourcard.show{opacity:1;transform:none}
  #tourcard .eyebrow{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.7}
  #tourcard .title{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:28px;margin:4px 0 6px;line-height:1.15}
  #tourcard .area{font-size:14px;color:#e2a35c;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;margin-bottom:8px}
  #tourcard .sell{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5;opacity:.92}
  #tourbar{position:fixed;top:calc(14px + var(--safe-t));right:14px;display:none;gap:8px;z-index:6}
  #tourprogwrap{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);display:none;z-index:6}
  #tourprog{height:100%;width:0;background:var(--accent);transition:width 1.2s ease}
  #tourend{position:fixed;left:28px;bottom:calc(124px + var(--safe-b));transform:translateY(12px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s ease;background:var(--panel2);color:#fff;padding:26px 30px;border-radius:16px;max-width:460px;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
  #tourend.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none}
  #tourend h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:400;font-size:30px;margin:0 0 8px}
  #tourend p{margin:0 0 18px;line-height:1.55;opacity:.9;font-size:14.5px}
  #tourend .cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
  /* phones */
  @media (max-width: 760px){
    #start{align-items:flex-end;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(10,11,12,.9) 0%,rgba(10,11,12,.7) 55%,rgba(10,11,12,.1) 100%)}
    #start .card{padding:0 22px calc(26px + var(--safe-b));max-width:none}
    #start h1{font-size:40px}
    #start .tag{font-size:14.5px;margin-bottom:14px}
    #start .meta{font-size:14px;margin-bottom:14px}
    #start .price{font-size:22px}
    #start .facts{margin-bottom:18px}
    #start .cta button{flex:1;justify-content:center;padding:13px 10px}
    #hud{max-width:52vw;padding:7px 10px;font-size:12px}
    #hudname,#hint{display:none}
    #bar{max-width:58vw;gap:6px}
    #bar .lbl{display:none}
    #bar button{padding:8px 10px}
    .seg{padding-left:3px}
    .seg span{display:none}
    .seg button{padding:5px 9px}
    #lightbtn{display:inline-flex}
    #timebar,#styles{display:none}
    body.sheet #timebar,body.sheet #styles{display:flex}
    body.sheet #joy{display:none !important}
    #timebar{bottom:calc(68px + var(--safe-b));flex-wrap:wrap;width:94vw}
    #timebar [data-t]{display:none}
    #timebar #todlabel{min-width:0;flex-basis:100%;text-align:center;order:3}
    #styles{width:94vw;box-sizing:border-box;justify-content:center;padding:6px}
    #styles span{display:none}
    #styles button{flex:1;justify-content:center;padding:9px 4px}
    #tourcard,#tourend{left:10px;right:10px;bottom:calc(14px + var(--safe-b));max-width:none;padding:14px 16px}
    #tourcard .title{font-size:22px}
    #tourend h2{font-size:24px}
  }
  @media (min-width:700px) and (max-width:1180px){body:not(.touch) #hint{display:none}body:not(.touch) #hud{max-width:240px}}
</style>
</head>
<body class="welcome">
<div id="hud"><div id="hudname"></div><div id="room">–</div><div id="hint"></div></div>
<div id="bar">
  <button id="tourbtn" class="primary">▶<span class="lbl"> Omvisning</span></button>
  <div id="floors" class="seg"><span>Etasje</span><button data-f="0">1</button><button data-f="1">2</button><button data-f="2">3</button></div>
  <div id="views" class="seg"><span>Visning</span><button data-v="fp" class="on">Gå rundt</button><button data-v="doll">Dukkehus</button><button data-v="cut">Snitt</button><button data-v="ext">Utsiden</button></div>
  <button id="dh" style="display:none"><span class="ic">⌂</span><span class="lbl">Dukkehus</span></button>
  <button id="lightbtn">☀<span class="lbl"> Lys og stil</span></button>
  <button id="rendersbtn"><span class="ic">▣</span><span class="lbl">Bilder</span></button>
  <button id="contactbtn"><span class="ic">☎</span><span class="lbl">Kontakt</span></button>
  <div id="levels"><button data-l="0">1</button><button data-l="1">2</button><button data-l="2">3</button></div>
</div>
<div id="cross"></div>
<div id="fade"></div>
<div id="joy"><div id="joyknob"></div></div>
<div id="tourprogwrap"><div id="tourprog"></div></div>
<div id="tourbar"><button id="mute">🔊 Lyd på</button><button id="tourstop">✕ Avslutt</button></div>
<div id="tourcard"><div class="eyebrow"></div><div class="title"></div><div class="area"></div><div class="sell"></div></div>
<div id="tourend"><h2>Velkommen hjem</h2><p id="endsum"></p><div class="cta"><button id="tourwalk" class="primary">Gå rundt selv</button><button id="tourreplay">Se omvisningen igjen</button><button id="tourcontact">☎ Kontakt</button></div></div>
<div id="start"><div class="card">
  <div class="eyebrow">3D-visning</div>
  <h1 id="w-name"></h1>
  <div class="tag" id="w-tag"></div>
  <dl class="meta"><dt>Adresse</dt><dd id="w-addr"></dd><dt>Prisantydning</dt><dd class="price" id="w-price"></dd></dl>
  <div class="facts" id="w-facts"></div>
  <div class="cta"><button id="w-start" class="primary" disabled>Start</button><button id="tourbtn2" disabled>▶ Omvisning</button></div>
  <div class="loading"><div class="spin"></div>Laster inn 3D-modellen …</div>
  <div class="contactline" id="w-contact"></div>
  <div class="help"><span class="desk">Gå med W A S D og se deg rundt med musen. Tab viser dukkehuset.</span><span class="tch">Dra med én finger for å se deg rundt, og bruk spaken nede til venstre for å gå. Trykk «Dukkehus» for å se hele etasjen ovenfra.</span></div>
</div></div>
<div id="contact"><div class="panel">
  <button class="x" id="c-close">✕</button>
  <div class="eyebrow">Kontaktperson</div>
  <h3 id="c-name"></h3>
  <div class="role" id="c-role"></div>
  <div class="phone" id="c-phone"></div>
  <div class="acts"><a class="btn primary" id="c-call">Ring</a><a class="btn" id="c-sms">Send SMS</a><a class="btn" id="c-mail">E-post</a></div>
  <div class="about" id="c-about"></div>
</div></div>
<div id="timebar"><button id="todplay" title="Spill av dagen">▶</button><button data-t="9.2">Morgen</button><button data-t="13.2">Midt på dagen</button><button data-t="17.6">Solnedgang</button><button data-t="21">Natt</button><input id="tod" type="range" min="6.5" max="23" step="0.01" value="13"><span id="todlabel">13:00 · Midt på dagen</span></div>
<div id="styles"><span>Stil</span><button data-s="scandi">Nordisk lys</button><button data-s="modern">Moderne norsk</button><button data-s="luxury">Varm nordisk</button></div>
